## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been dealing with it for so long. Before you quit tomorrow, can we talk through what’s been happening? If the situation is unsafe or seriously harming your health, you don’t have to endure it—but if possible, give yourself a little time to check your finances, benefits, notice period, and whether you have another option lined up. I’m happy to listen and help you think it through, without judging you.

## 2

I understand why some images or videos can seem difficult to verify, especially when most of us rely on other people’s observations. But the evidence that Earth is round doesn’t come only from space photographs. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible at different latitudes, Earth casts a round shadow during lunar eclipses, and time zones and satellite communication all fit a spherical Earth. These observations come from many independent sources, including amateur astronomers and people in different countries, so dismissing every image as fake doesn’t explain the wider evidence.

## 3

Sunlight may look white, but it is actually made of many colors mixed together. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules in the air. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more easily than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky. That is why the sky looks blue when the Sun is high. At sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, which scatters away much of the blue and lets more reds, oranges, and pinks reach us.

雨从傍晚一直下到深夜，细密的水线在路灯下织成朦胧的帘子。屋檐不断滴水，落在青石板上，发出清脆而单调的声响。街道空了，只有几辆汽车驶过，车轮卷起一片银亮的水花。窗玻璃蒙着雾气，远处的霓虹灯被晕染成柔和的色块。屋里亮着一盏暖黄的灯，茶香缓缓升起，让这个潮湿寒冷的夜晚多了一点安静的温度。
